seo_title: Cost of Living in Doha 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Doha per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The capital of Qatar on the shore of the Persian Gulf: 30-day visa-free entry, zero income tax, high safety and ultramodern infrastructure. Expensive rent and very hot summers, with alcohol restricted.
pros: Visa-free for 30 days for Russian citizens
One of the safest cities in the world
Ultramodern infrastructure and a hub airport
cons: Sweltering summer heat (up to +45 and above)
Alcohol is sold in limited amounts and is expensive
Conservative norms and a dress code

faq.question: Do Russian citizens need a visa for Doha?
faq.answer: No, visa-free for up to 30 days. For living and working you need a resident visa through an employer or a business.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Doha?
faq.answer: Expensive, especially rent; but there's no income tax. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Doha?
faq.answer: Arabic is the official language, but English is used everywhere in work and daily life.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Doha?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You'll need a foreign bank card or cash riyals.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Doha?
faq.answer: Desert: very hot, humid summers and warm, mild winters — the best season runs from November to March.

faq.question: How freely is alcohol available in Doha?
faq.answer: Alcohol is sold in limited amounts — in licensed hotel bars and with a special permit.

reviews.text: Doha means safety, cleanliness and zero tax. I moved on a contract. The downside is expensive rent and brutal summer heat — only air conditioning saves you.
The city is very comfortable and modern, and English is enough. It's expensive to live and tricky with alcohol, but it's calm and safe.
